name: t5s_us15_500m
description: Phase 3 T5s section 4.2's OWN CONTINGENCY: the U_s=15 m/s sweep member re-run at 500 m. T5 section 6.1's resolution caveat is that 1 km under-resolves 5-10 km cells, so the 1 km sweep cannot distinguish 'the rotation genuinely persists' from 'the grid cannot resolve the individual cells whose rotation would break the chain'. THE ONLY THING THAT MOVES IS HORIZONTAL RESOLUTION. nx and ny double while dx and dy halve EXACTLY (360 x 499.5 m = 179820 m = 180 x 999 m), so this is an exact 2x refinement of the same physical domain on aligned cell edges -- which is what makes the block-average check in the plan possible. nz, dz, timax, tapfrq, dtl, adapt_dt, imove, umove, irandp, iinit, iorigin, icor, ptype, ihail and the ENTIRE sounding block are byte-for-byte the values of t5s_us15.json; the generated input_sounding must therefore have the same sha256, and that identity is a gate, not a hope. dtl stays 6.0 deliberately: adapt_dt=1 recomputes dt from CFL at the first adaptation (measured at 1 km: 6.0 -> 6.6 -> 7.26 while cflmax stayed near 0.06), so dtl is a seed value and not a constraint, and leaving it alone keeps the config diff to the grid alone. np=8 rather than the sweep's np=4 because this is a single run, not a concurrent pair (charter, production run config). Scoring and its three branches are pre-registered in docs/plan-science-hurdles-2026-09-02.md section 4.2 and sim/probes/README.md; NOTHING in the classifier is re-tuned for this run.
